text: This report provides a status update on Council's requests to the Government of Ontario to implement enhanced income supports, reinstate a moratorium on evictions of residential tenants, and provide paid sick days as additional measures to reduce the prevalence and impact of COVID-19, particularly in communities with many residents who lack adequate financial or employment security.
City Council on December 16, 17 and 18, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the report (December 10, 2020) from the City Manager for information.
